description_zh: 一辆车在弯道中撞到右侧混凝土桥台，无其他道路使用者参与，属于单车失控碰撞固定物体，无第二交互参与者。
reason: 属于单车冲出路缘/失控（无第二参与者）类事故，无测试价值的双方交互。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle in manual mode was traveling eastbound on Lombard St. towards Leavenworth St. following a sharp curve in the road when it made contact with a concrete abutment on the right.
